newsitem.title: UK: Unilever suing Nestle over "Aero"-UK newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Unilever suing Nestle over "Aero"-UK newspaper.

text.p: Anglo-Dutch consumer foods group Unilever is suing Nestle, the world's largest food company, to stop the Swiss company producing the "Aero" ice cream it launched last year, the Times reported.
Unilever claims Nestle is infringing the patent it had for a short-lived chocolate ice cream called "Sky", the paper said. The writ demands Nestle destroy its Aero ice cream stocks.

Although it withdrew the Sky bar in 1993, Unilever claims the patent it received in 1992 gives it exclusive rights to make "ice cream products with a core of aerated chocolate" -- exactly the description of Aero -- the paper said.
Aero is Britain's 10th biggest selling chocolate with annual sales of more than 60 million pounds.
